entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: On the basis of race?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, Mr. Speaker, Sir.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: On the basis of tribe?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, Mr. Speaker, Sir.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: You have been accused of abusing your office by enriching yourself. Do you recall receiving Kshs50 million in the budget of 2018/2019?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, Mr. Speaker, Sir. However, at this juncture, there was a confirmation budget of Kshs50 million that was allocated to me by MCAs. We did not use that budget. I think the document is annexed in one of the affidavits. They wanted me to be part and parcel of their scandals in swindling tax payers' money. I refused the Kshs50 million that was allocated to me in the budget and it was returned to the National Treasury at the end of the financial year. I never touched a coin.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City Governor)
entries.text: You steered away from touching City County money?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, Sir.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: You have allegations made against you that you have stolen county money. Therefore, you are facing two anti-corruption cases. Have you been found guilty in those cases?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, Mr. Speaker, Sir. At this juncture, I know that we are running out of time, but there is a very sensitive clip. The seconder of this Motion--- I remember the Senate at some point resolved that Jambo Pay Services should be terminated. That is on the affidavit; the Counsel will look for it. The Seconder of this Motion, the CEO of Jambo Pay, came to my house in Kanamai. It is captured by the Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI) because the case was under investigation. The DCI officers came with their recorders, and a certificate was done. They captured the current Nairobi City County Assembly Majority Leader, hon. Abdi Hassan Guyo and Jambo Pay CEO. The transcript and the audio from the DCI is there. The case is still under investigation. They told me " Wewe ni ni mjinga . Hutaki kukula ." I want that clip to be prepared by the ICT. It was captured by the DCI. They told me " Wewe ni mjinga. Hutaki kukula. Sisi na Kidero tumekula Kshs7 billion in five years. Wewe unatukanyagia."

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: As they prepare that clip, the Mover of the Motion " kulad ". I am sorry. I recall that word.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text:
Towards the end of that clip, they offered me Kshs5 million a day from the county revenue. They gave me staff to work with them. They did not know that I had a DCI recorder. The case is still ongoing, and the file has already been forwarded to the Director of Public Prosecutions (DPP). I told them: " sawa, I am ready." They told me how they were stealing and how I will be making the Kshs5 million a day. In a month that was supposed to be Kshs150 million and Kshs1.8 billion in a year. I refused, and, therefore, became an enemy of everyone in the Assembly and anyone who was stealing county funds. In this clip, the CEO of Jambo Pay was telling me:, " wewe umetafutwa sana .

Hupatikani. Ni kwa nini hutaki kukula. Wewe ni mtoto wa wapi? Hii pesa ni ya kaunti nasio yako."

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (A video clip was played)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Go to where the Majority Leader told me that they stole Kshs7 billion in five years na mimi sitakikukula. Mwisho ni ile ya kuchukua Kshs5 million a day.

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (A video clip was played)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, that is the Majority Leader, a seconder of this Motion. He came to my house with the CEO of the Jambo Pay Services and told me that mimi sitaki kukula. Tuibe pesa ya ummapamoj a. I refused. Go towards the end, where they were offering me Kshs5 million a day. Because of time, you cannot air the entire clip.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Actually, your time is up.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, Sir. I apologize. That clip took a bit longer. They are playing the last bit.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Go to towards the end where I am being offered Kshs5 million a day by the CEO of Jambo Pay Services.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: While they play the clip, let me ask you a few questions.

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (A video clip was played)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, Mr. Speaker, Sir, because of time---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Let me ask you, Your Excellency, who is this telling about who took Kshs7 billion? Who is the one telling that story or narrative?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: That is the Majority Leader of Nairobi City County Assembly and the seconder of this Motion to impeach me.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: In all the documents and the evidence that you had from the mover, did he present? Did you see? Were you shown a penny moving from the county government coffers to your account?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Any penny? One shilling? Not even a penny?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Let me wind up. As you have addressed the issue of the motivation of this Impeachment Motion, is it not true that on the 23rd of November, 2020, you reported to the DCI that the mover of the Motion had taken Kshs823,324? That is on page 59 and 60 of your Volume 10H. That is the letter that you wrote to the DCI on 23rd of November, 2020, two days before the Impeachment Motion.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes. We annexed all the vouchers and air tickets. The voucher is there on page 60 on how the money was disbursed to his account.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: He acknowledged, so that we save time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: He said and pleaded that he was going to return the funds?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Now, the question is: Did you receive any documents from the Mover of the Motion in connection with his payment, the refund of this money?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: I wind up by asking you the last question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Your time is up.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: My very last question. Your Excellency, you have shown and demonstrated that the motivation of this impeachment Motion is not about your efficiency or lack thereof. Your CECs have been functioning and all departments have been functioning. Have you ever been summoned to the county assembly in the manner that you are now before this honourable Members to answer the questions about the movement of funds, the use of resources in the Nairobi City County or the abuse that is alleged against you by your CECs to answer any of them?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: How do you plead? How do you plead to these charges? Guilty or not guilty?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Not guilty.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: And you ask these hon. Members to look at that evidence and say 'no impeachment.' Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Sir, and hon. Members.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Thank you. Counsel, before you come, I know that we ran out of time that was given to the Governor. As we all know, the impeachment of a governor is a weighty matter. Therefore, we want to give every party a fair opportunity and chance. Therefore, I will give you one hour to cross-examine the Governor. Please, try as much as possible, to operate within that one hour because the schedule is long.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Sir. As it was placed, we will be asking for latitude and magnanimity from your bench, so that we deal and give justice to this case. Your Excellency, Gov. Mike Mbuvi Sonko, good afternoon?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.speaker_title: (The Governor of the Nairobi City County)
entries.text: Good afternoon.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I will be asking you some questions in respect to the proceedings before us. I believe that you have had an opportunity to look at the charges that have been levelled against you.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: The Governor of Nairobi City County (Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko)
entries.text: Yeah.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Before I go to that, Mr. Governor, allow me to ask you whether you are the same person - and you only need to answer yes or no - who appears in the name of Kioko Mike Sonko Mbuvi Gideon. Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Sonko
entries.text: Those are the same names.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mbuvi Gideon Kioko Mike Sonko.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Those are the same names. You are just repeating.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Are you also Mbuvi Gideon Kioko. Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Those are the same names. You are just repeating. Are you also Mbuvi Gideon Kioko alias Mike Sonko Mbuvi Gideon alias Mbuvi Kioko alias---? Are you the same person? There is no difference.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes or no?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: There is no difference. You are just repeating yourself.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, did you have a look at your description in the charge sheet in case number 32 of 2019? Did you?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, I looked at the description.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Just answer yes or no, you have had a look at it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: That is sub judice. That is a matter still in court. I have not been convicted. Mr. Speaker, Sir---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, I am the one asking you questions. Kindly cooperate.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: I need to follow. Let us have some order.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I am much obliged. You read evidence in this Senate in respect to the bursary diversion. Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Which bursaries were you dressing? Which financial were you addressing in your videos?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: The Governor of Nairobi City County (Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko)
entries.text: Two financial years, 2017/2018, 2018/2019 and 2019/2020.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It is your evidence that the 2019/2020 bursary was never uploaded to your account. Yes? Yes or no?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It was uploaded, but money was never released by the Treasury because of COVID-19; schools were closed. The money was released back to the Central Bank of Kenya (CBK).

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, do you remember showing us a video clip here of a certain girl somewhere in a slum?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You were demonstrating that she received approximately Kshs.53,000 of the cheque.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbubvi Sonko
entries.text: That was for the previous financial year, and not for 2019/2020.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you recall or you do not recall?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I recall, but not for that financial year.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Counsel, take him slow. You are pushing him too fast.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Okay, I will be slow with him. I am mindful of time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You just want to annoy me. I will not play your card. Just talk I will be calm.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you recall telling us that that is six months ago? Yes or no?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Six months ago---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you recall or you do not recall?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Those were allegations by your client. They even said we spent the money for---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Counsel, what is your intervention?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, his Excellency the Governor should be given leeway room to answer so that Hon. Members can be clear about the answer to the issues.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: I have already pronounced myself on that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, much obliged.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, ask the witness to answer the question that is put to him. If I need a yes or no, let him answer so.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. I am not going to mislead this House like what your client did. I have to give correct answer because I am on oath.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Which financial year were you presenting the cheques in respect to the six months ago?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Six months ago was not about presentation of cheques. Six months ago was about the allegations made by your client that we diverted bursary funds to pay legal fees.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Are you recanting your evidence?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I think you are trying to mislead the House. I cannot go to that angle. I will speak the truth because just two months ago---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Open your big volume, 10H on page 234. What does that document relate to?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: On page 234 are bank statements.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: For which year?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: From 2016.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is that the year under trial in the Senate?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This is the year in which your client swindled taxpayers' money to enrich their families and wives.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You had a list of advocates that were supposed to represent you in these proceedings. Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you remember putting in a notice of appointment? Correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: The Governor of Nairobi City County (Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko)
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Would you grab your notice of appointment?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Would you grab a copy of the same?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes. My lawyers are looking for it. If you have a copy, you can give me.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Would you read the list of the advocates appearing that you intended to present before the Senate?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Evans Ondiek. Wilfred Nyamu. Diana Kethi Kilonzo, who is represented by Dan Maanzo.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Just proceed. I have not asked you for explanation.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: George Kithi, Kwanga Mboya and Cecil Miller.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Good. I want to deal with the last three, Kithi, Mboya and Cecil Miller. You heard me yesterday making an application for their summons. Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Did you have a look at those summonses that were presented before the Senate?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I was not party to those summons.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I will show you. Look at the persons we sought their summons. Who is No.9?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: The Governor of Nairobi City County (Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko)
entries.text: Kwanga Mboya.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is that your advocate?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Proceed. Read the next column.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I cannot go to the next column without answering the questions asked. Which number is that?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Read the next column, Governor.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Kwanga Mboya and Company Advocates to shed light on single payments of up to Kshs80 million deposited in the firm's account in July 2019.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What documents were we seeking from that advocate?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Sonko
entries.text: The documents for these advocates are here.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Wilfred Nyamu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, at this juncture, I wish to request to interject on an objection. Reference to the advocates, Kwanga Mboya and Cecil Miller, is in relation to an issue that arose in the morning and this House rejected. Arousing the same would warrant admission of further documents at this particular point, which is past the hour. I would urge my learned friend to desist from that line of cross-examination and deal with the issues that are within the House. If he wants us to answer, then we need to have documents admitted so that they may be relied upon the House.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Hon. Lusaka)
entries.text: Are you saying that the documents he has given to the Governor were not admitted?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Wilfred Nyamu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, the only way he can answer those questions---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Hon. Lusaka)
entries.text: No, answer me. Are you saying the document as given by the Governor was not admitted? If it was not, then I will not accept it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Wilfred Nyamu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: It is only the notice of appointment that is admitted. However, in relation to questions that have been put touching on those firms of advocates, that evidence was rejected by this court in the morning. Nonetheless, the Governor says he can answer. However, for him to answer, we need to have those documents admitted.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Nyamu, you do not have to be afraid of anything, you will have your time to rebut. It is now my time to bite the cherry

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, on a point of order. Governor, you are my witness.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Just a minute counsel.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I cannot allow the counsel to proceed in this manner. His client, the Mover of the Motion, made grievous allegations about me and the County Government of Nairobi City. He has made allegations on counsel who are acting for the counties and were paid. There were court orders. On the case of Kwanga--

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I have not put any question to him.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You have given me a copy which has details of county lawyers who were paid. It is not corruption money. We were allocated Kshs8 billion by the World Bank to construct markets and fire stations in Nairobi City County. If you look at the brief of the World Bank, they are withdrawing the Kshs8 billion because of land grabbing and they had challenges. There is an encroachment of a 10 storey building by one Musa Chelago Yego, former flying squad commander.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, we seek your guidance. Which question is the witness answering? I have not put a question to him.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: He is clarifying. Order! Order, counsel!

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I just need a minute to finish that. We demolished this building since we did not want to lose funds from the World Bank. We demolished the building and the fire station was constructed and it is complete today. The owner of the building, who is the flying squad commander, retired two months ago, took us to the constitutional court in Petition No.218 of 2018; Petitioner Musa Yego. The respondent is Nairobi City County Government. We lost the case and the ruling is here. There is a decree; we were forced by the court to pay Kshs80 million which was paid to Kwanga Mboya for transmission to the vendor's lawyer, which we did. In this case the fees for Kwanga Mboya is only Kshs4 million. We have never paid a coin. It is similar to the case for Ruaraka where taxpayer's money of Kshs1 billion was lost. The land for Ruaraka Primary school worth Kshs4 billion was reverted back to the County Government of Nairobi. These are legal fees and court orders.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Counsel, put your question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Sir. What documents did we seek or were we seeking from them? The next column, what documents were we seeking from that advocate?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Which advocate?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Kwanga Mboya.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Are you seeing some documents? I am not aware. Explain to me.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Wilfred Nyamu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, we are going to an arena that we passed in the morning. He is referring to documents that are not admitted. He wants to cross-examine---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: That is the question I asked you. You are just circumlocuting. I asked whether the document given to the Governor was admitted or not.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, that is the letter we wrote to this honorable House. The documents written to this House in respect to a matter become subject of a matter. This is what we call the doctrine of legestae, facts otherwise not relevant becoming relevant. These are the summonses that become part of the records.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Let us proceed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Sir for the protection. Governor, read the documents.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I can read. Where do you want me to read?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That column.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The column, 'prequalification by the county government---'

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What are we asking? What other document were we seeking?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Letter of instruction for the case, fee note, tax compliance certificate and evidence of tax payment and the date of payment.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is Mr. Kwanga Mboya before this House as your advocate this afternoon?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes. You are also representing your clients. At the end of the day the Assembly is going to pay. There is nothing wrong with that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is he present?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, he is not accused.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Let us go to Cecil Miller. What documents were we asking for?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Those are your colleagues, you should have written to them directly instead of asking me these questions. The instructions come from the county attorney not from the governor. I am not supposed to answer to these questions; this is my impeachment.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, you will answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Okay.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: If you want to be acquitted by this House you will answer the questions and not choose what to say and what to do. You are a witness. How much did you say Kwanga Mboya was paid?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: He was paid Kshs80 million after a decree that was issued by Justice--the order is here with me.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: How much was he paid?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: He was paid Kshs80 million. The ruling is by Justice Mativo.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do not take documents that are not before the Senate.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The court order is in public domain. If you google the Kenya Law Reports you will get this order.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: When was he paid that amount? When was Kwanga Mboya paid?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I have got the bank receipts and the voucher with me. Let me just check. Give me a minute, I will answer you right now.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: We are limiting on the documents I have. These are not documents before the Senate. The ones that he is referring to.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You have answered a question of when he was paid. I have got the bank statement on how the RTGS was paid to him after one hour to transfer the money to the vendor's lawyer. His fees, which he raised to us, was Kshs4 million. He was paid on 16th July, 2019. He is talking about funds being diverted for 2020.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: How much was Cecil Miller paid?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Counsel, let me finish. You have asked the question and I have not finished answering.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Let him answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Enda pole pole, wacha speed. Mimi sipelekangwi mbio. I am a fan of cases. Mr. Speaker, Sir, the money was paid from the county account on the 16th July 2019 to Kwanga Mboya's account 0113623028200, Kwanga Mboya and Company Advocates. The same day after one-hour, Kwanga Mboya remitted the monies to beneficiary Okoth and Kiplagat and Company advocates who was Musa Yego's lawyer. Based on a decree that was issued by Justice Mativo of the High Court of Kenya vide case number I have mentioned.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, with your kind permission, if I will not be allowed to lead the witness, we will not lead the evidence that we have. The witness will have the risk of going on the frolic of his own as he is now doing.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You are the one who raised the question, counsel.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: What I want is that you give him time to respond.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, he cannot respond to the question that he has not been asked. That is the purpose of cross-examination.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Okay, proceed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: So, when was he paid?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: To the statement again, he was paid on 16th July, 2019.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: How much or what was the invoice that he had raised?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The invoice is here with me. Being payment, this is the legal fee--'being payment of legal fees in respect of Petition No.218 of 2018, Musa Yego versus Nairobi City County Government. The invoice for his fees was Kshs5 million. I have not finished.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have answered my question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You referred me to the invoice; let me finish the details of the invoice.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have answered my question. I am satisfied with the answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Kshs6 million is not the total payment we have deducted the taxes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am satisfied with that answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am not satisfied with my answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Order, Governor! You are not the one who asked the question, so you cannot be satisfied with your own answer. Wait for the next question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am on oath; I do not want to give a misleading answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir can this witness be controlled?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Counsel, hold on.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Kshs5 million as per the invoice is not the final legal payment.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That question was put.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This was the initial amount and taxes had to be removed. The final legal fee we were supposed to pay Kwanga Mboya is Kshs4 million and not Kshs5 million.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am also satisfied.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The House was not satisfied.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I now lead you to the blue file. Do you have it? E (1). The big file.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, I can look for it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you have it, Governor? The big blue file.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: The Governor of Nairobi City
entries.text: County (Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko): Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Go with me very fast to page 77.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I will not go with you. I will just go to page 77. Why should I go with you? Let me look for it. I cannot go with you. I can go alone.

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (Laughter)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I am looking for the file. Which page, please?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Page 77. Open with me page 77.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Which volume, please?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The blue file. Yes, that one. Governor, are you on page 77?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, Sir.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is a copy of the extracts of the Integrated Financial Management System (IFMIS), yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I want you to look at the entry labeled 0305. Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is not visible.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You will see, Mr. Governor. This one is visible.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Come and show me.

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (Mr. Ndegwa Njiru showed him the document)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Can you read out the details?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Let me put on my torch. I cannot see.

entries.label: speech
entries.text: (Hon. Lusaka) Is it getting darker?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, it is faint. The font is---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Read that entry. What does it relate to?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: 15th July, 2019?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What action is taking place on the next column?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Outward transmission of Kshs80 million.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, who was the recipient?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Apollo Mboya and Company Advocates.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Apollo Mboya and Company Advocates, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Not Apollo Mboya, there is no Apollo Mboya.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Sorry, there is no Apollo. It is Kwanga Mboya.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You are misleading the House.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Kwanga Mboya, Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Kshs80 million was paid on the 15th against an invoice of Kshs5 million. Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Sorry?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Kinyanjui, would you let the witness be?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Proceed, Counsel. There was Khs80 million in favour of Kwanga Mboya.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Look at the entry labeled 3 (i).

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, I am there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What does it relate to?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The same date of the 15th?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes. What action is taking place?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: A payment of Kshs30 million to Abdullahi Gitari---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: A Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS), yes? How much was paid?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: On 15th July 2019, one year ago, he was paid---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It is okay. I will go to the next page, page 78. Entry 306. Can you see it?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Why are you---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Governor.

entries.label: speech
entries.text: (Hon.) Lusaka): Order!

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Entry 306.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What action is taking place? What date and what action?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Repeat yourself, please?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Entry 306. What date is it?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This page has no entry 306. There is only 305. Maybe I go to the next page. On page 77, there is only 305. The top is 2018, not 306. Mr. Speaker, Sir, he is misleading the House.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You are not referring to the whole document. I told you to refer to page 78.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You said 77, this is 77.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Page 78.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Give me page 78. You have not given me page 78. Let me look for it, please. You asked for 77, now you are asking for 78.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, 78.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Okay, I will look for 78.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Look at the entry labelled 306.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Okay.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, be mindful of time. Move very fast. What action is taking place in 306?

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (Loud consultations)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am there, Mr. Speaker, Sir.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What action is taking place?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, there is another transaction on 15th July 2019, not 2020. I do not know where your allegations are heading to. These are payments of Nairobi City County, paying Cecil Miller and Company Advocates.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: How much was paid to Cecil Miller?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Kshs80 million.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Kshs83 million, correct? I want you to confirm that all this amount of money was paid on the same day on 15th July, 2019. Correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is correct, and it is not a big deal when money is reflected to the county account from the Exchequer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have heard us alleging and adducing evidence that that is the money that was meant for the bursary. Yes? Go with me to page one.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, let me answer the question. I cannot go there. Let me answer the question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Let him answer, then you will go.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, the lawyer is behaving like his client. He just wants to mislead the House. I was very clear about the bursary funds. These transactions are dated 15th July 2019. The financial year ended in September 2020. There is proof that the funds were transferred back to the Central Bank of Kenya (CBK). They were not used.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, what budget are we questioning in our ground one?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You are questioning the bursary budget, and I have answered that. I have given you proof that no coin was used from the bursary fund. Go to the CBK statement and see. The money is there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I hear you. Now hear me. Kindly confirm that the budget that you are dealing with is 2019/2020. Yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: There were several budgets for---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I want you to confirm. Yes, or no.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I referred to three different budgets in these proceedings.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I want you to confirm. I have told you what I am dealing with now. Not those other ones.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: We are dealing with that budget, Mr. Governor.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, Mr. Speaker, Sir. These are problems for the financial year.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: When does the government year begin to run?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Let me see.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: When does it begin to run?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, this is July. It is true, the next Financial Year, 2019/2020.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is the financial year that we are dealing with, yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Good. I want to refer you to the same file, and now go to page one.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: that is an invoice, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Let me get it first, please. I got it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: are you there, G overnor?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What does that invoice relate to?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This is a payment for the transfer of bursary funds. This is a handwritten document, so I do not know the authenticity of this.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It is okay. It is the same document you referred to.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is handwritten. It is not an electronic document. The CBK statement.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, how much money is in issue in that invoice?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Sorry?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: How much money is in issue? How much money are we looking at?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Kshs297, 500, 000 in 2019, and it went directly to the Co-operative Bank account.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is okay. I have not asked where it went. Confirm to this House that that is the money appearing on ground one of the charges.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. It is a total lie. The money---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I have asked you the figures.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, it is a total lie.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, hear me out. Confirm that Kshs297,500,000 is the money in question or the subject of these proceedings.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Can you allow me to answer you?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: No, confirm.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I want to answer the question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Let him answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, as I have said earlier, the allocation for bursary for Financial Year 2018/2019 was Kshs297,500,000. I aired a clip showing the cheque for the same amount. I have a statement showing how this amount was utilised. From the CRF Account, it went to Co- operative Account and we have a list of all the beneficiaries.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: But he is talking about 2019.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: That was 2019. We also allocated a similar amount for Financial Year 2019/2020. That is Kshs297,500,000 for bursary. We have a statement from the CBK confirming that. The funds were not disbursed from the Exchequer in September due to COVID-19 challenges. Since schools were closed, we returned the money back to the CBK and the statements are there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I hear you, Mr. Governor. However, as much as I hear you, I want you to refer to page 76 of the same document. Are you there?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Give me a minute please.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Kinyanjui, do not coach the witness because he is my witness. You will have time when I yield.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am the Senate witness and not your witness, please. Mr. Speaker, Sir, I have got the document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Are you there?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, look at entry labelled 261. What date is it?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The date is 12th July, 2019.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What action was taking place?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The action was outward RTGS of---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: RTGS from which account to which account?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: From CBK to the county account. Let me just confirm.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: No, Mr. Governor.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: A second kindly.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Just hold on. What is your intervention, Sen. Olekina?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ledama Olekina
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I am not sure whether I am the only visitor in Jerusalem. I have no clue of the documents they are referring to. I am trying to follow but I cannot see. I got lost in between the documents which were introduced and these current ones. If they refer as to the documents, we will follow.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Counsel, which documents are you referring to?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: We are referring to this big blue file labelled as 9A. Mr. Kinyanjui, stop coaching the witness.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Counsel Kinyanjui, you were the one complaining yesterday.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I do not know why he is losing the decorum of a senior counsel.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Take your seat.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I was informing His Excellency the Governor---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You should seek leave of the Chair.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I raised my hand and you allowed me. I think Mr. Njiru did not see that. Hon. Members, I do not mean any disrespect. I was whispering to His Excellency the Governor, because Mr. Njiru was addressing another issue, that the file we are referencing are their documents. So, I am taking a little longer to look for them.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, I am assuming that now you have the document? Correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Sonko
entries.text: Let me go back to the document because you have somehow confused me. Did you say page 76?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Look at page 76, entry labelled 261. Which date is that?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Sonko
entries.text: The date is 12th July, 2019. That is RTGS auto-transmission from the CBK to Nairobi County Account. The amount is Kshs297,500,000.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Confirm that this is the account for the Nairobi City County.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I confirm.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Confirm that the money in issue came from the CBK.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, to Nairobi County Government Account.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Finally, confirm that the money was Kshs297,500,000.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Then, Mr. Governor, expeditiously explain the manner in which you distributed that money.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: That is a good question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Listen, Governor. Is this the money you said was returned to the CBK?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you have evidence of---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: A question cannot answer another question. I have given you time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Confirm that this is the money that was---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I cannot confirm because an answer cannot answer another answer. Let me give you an answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: You answer what he has asked systematically.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Let me refresh.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I do not want you to refresh. I got the question, let me answer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: This is like a court and we need to follow the proceedings. Let us conduct ourselves in a civil manner.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, allow me to refresh the question for his benefit.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: He says he has heard the question. Let him answer. It does not need to be refreshed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I have heard the question. Let me answer it. The counsel is repeating himself by the way he is asking questions. Mr. Speaker, Sir, the counsel is referring to the disbursement of the bursaries for 2019. Immediately after his clients were charged in court---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is not the question. I will come to that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: That is the way I want to answer. You have a way of asking questions and I have got a way of answering. Kindly give me time to answer. I will take less than a minute.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, you gave a ruling yesterday.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Hold on counsel.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, you gave us directions that when a question requiring "Yes" or "No" is put,- this was confirmed by Sen. Madzayo, - an answer must be given in that nature.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Counsel, just relax.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The answer is "No" and I have reasons why. So, let me explain. I am on oath and cannot lie to the House. I was once a Senator and know the repercussions of lying. This House has got powers equivalent to the High Court. I can be charged with perjury---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Proceed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Just relax and let me answer. Mr. Speaker, Sir, with all due respect, the counsel is misleading the House. Immediately after his clients were charged in court for stealing taxpayers' money by directing to their wives accounts, I stopped the process of issuing cheques directly to MCAs. We agreed that all payments should be made through the bank, then the County using its Co-operative Bank account transmits the money through RTGS direct to schools. Transaction No.261 on page 76 that the counsel is referring to was on 12th July, 2019. This is a genuine transaction. On the same date, this same amount was captured in the statements.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, if you may, may we just speak to the documents before you?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Governor, are those documents with us?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: They are not filed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, this is a statement from Co-operative Bank. The same he is talking about is found in the statement for bursaries for previous years. The money was transferred to Co-operative Bank account and there is a list of all the beneficiaries of over 100,000 students.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, the document is not before you.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: If it is not filed, then you cannot use it. That is the rule.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Correct.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: What is it, counsel?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor (Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui)
entries.text: Hon. Senators, Mr. Kwanga Mboya sought to produce these documents. He pleaded because he has been negatively implicated by that notice of summons. Please, allow me to produce this whole bunch so that I can demonstrate what has been alleged against him. He has now referred to the documents disputing the alleged receipt of Ksh10million---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Order. He had asked for that yesterday, but yesterday he was already out of time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I am sorry. It was because the summons was sought for by Mr. Ndegwa Njiru. The ruling was delivered by yesterday that he should be summoned and yet he was not originally among the witnesses sought by the prosecuting team. When the grant was made that summons can be issued he immediately rose and said, "May I have the leave to have the documents brought in? We anticipated although it is wrong to anticipate pursuant to your rules that he could produce these documents in defense of his position.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: I am closing. I am justifying why because an attack has been made on the Governor, why are you referring to documents you have not brought? They are the authors of this scenario with respect. They served their notification late. Had they told us in advance on the 15th ---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, Mr. Kinyanjui is eating into our time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, that is the reason why documents---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The application is belated. Governor, answer the question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Governor, proceed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is that the amount of money you said was returned to the CBK?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, the amount of money returned to CBK, yes, it is the same.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you have evidence of return?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, I have got the CBK Statement.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Have you tabled that evidence before this House?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, when I was testifying in the morning, I tabled the documents in my affidavit. The amounts in figures are the same in Financial Year 2018/2019 and 2019/2020.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Let us make progress.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, with all due respect, some of the documents---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Take the next document 9B.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, with your permission, please?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Yes, Governor.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, as my counsel indicated earlier, the counsel served us with his files and affidavits past 7.00 p.m. the day they were supposed to be filed. We requested for these Statements at cooperative Bank of Kenya. They are very voluminous over 600 pages. We were delayed by the bank in printing of these documents. They were sent to me today in the morning. With all due respect as a Member of this House, I am requesting, because we made 80 copies. I do not know, if in the interest of time, I can be allowed to serve a copy to the Clerk or to you. The files he is referring to---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, you have pronounced yourself on that issue. Let us proceed, Governor.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am requesting the House from another angle. You have never been a Senator, my friend. We have our language on which I am appealing to colleagues.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Governor, I have heard your question. I will respond to that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Sir.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Proceed, counsel.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, do you have this volume of document labeled 10 H? It is your document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, Sir.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Please open with me page 170.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I am there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What is the document that you are looking at?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: These are CBK transactions showing stopped RTGS payments.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: When is it dated?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is dated 1st September, 2020 and the transaction is for 12th July, 2019.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: How much money is issued?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
