entries.text: The same. I have told you the allocation for bursary fund was the same. It is the same for 2019 and 2020.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is that document indicating a refund or return of that amount?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This is a refund because it is saying "stopped" and by then there were no allocations from the Exchequer because of COVID-19 challenges.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: When was it refunded?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This is another financial year. This was refunded---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am asking: When was that money refunded?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This document has been authenticated.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, when was the money refunded?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It was not refunded; it was not even available.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: When was it returned?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: All the counties did not have money.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am looking at the date. When?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It was withdrawn from the IB it does not mean it was returned.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Which date?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: On 1st September, 2020 but the transaction we are talking of 16th July, 2019 is captured in the Statement on the same date. It went to all the schools through RTGS.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I know why I am asking all these questions. Governor, I am aware that you know the provisions of Section 30 of the County Government Act, yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You know it relates to the functions of the Governor, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I know you are aware that among the functions of the Governor is to be accountable for the management and use of the country resources. Is that one of your functions?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, but in the recent ruling in the Waiguru impeachment proceedings---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am reading the law. I am putting it to you that Section 30 requires you to be accountable for the management and use of the county resources.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, if I have broken one of those laws but for now I have not broken anything.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, you are aware that the buck stops with you in the management and accountability---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: In some of the areas and issues but in some of them each officer---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, Counsel Kinyanjui is passing notes to Governor and it is very offensive. Mr. Kinyanjui, be honorable as a senior counsel.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: I want to now caution you now. This is not a market. This is the Senate of the Republic of Kenya sitting here now as a court. If you do not behave with decorum I will have no choice but ask you to leave. Proceed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You are also aware that among the functions that you have is to submit county plans and policies to the County Assembly for approvals. Is that your function, yes or no?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, before I proceed this is a simple note from Mr. Kinyanjui. I will give it to the Serjeant-at-Arms to pass it over to you. He is advising me: "Just be calm, the lawyers will annoy you, respect the hon. Senate." The advocate is advising me. I can give it to the Serjeant-at-Arms to give to you.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: He knows that is wrong.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: We take that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, you can consult your advocate during proceedings.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, you are aware that among your functions is to submit the county plans and polices to the County Assembly. Is that so?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I now want to refer you to a file labeled as 9B. Are you there?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Let me look for it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: No, he needs to be given the file.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It is the black file. Move with me to page 631. I can share this with you. Are you there?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Before that, move with speed to confirm that that is the tender document relating to Dandora stadium.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, it is.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Could you kindly read out the description of that project where it is highlighted?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Proposed stadia with a 3000 capacity seating on concrete terraces and steel strass light carbon iron sheets.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Correct. What was the stadium to be constructed of?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Concrete.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Concrete terraces. Move with me to page 808. It is Page 808, governor. You will not be there if you go with that speed. Confirm before we read that letter to whom the project or the tender was awarded.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Scanjet Construction Limited.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel of the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Scanjet Construction, yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Look at the letter dated 12th September, 2018. Who is the author?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The Chief Officer, Urban Renewal, Housing and project Management.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is that your officer?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is that officer under you?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: She is no longer there with us.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am not asking the personality. It is the office.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: She is not my officer. She is no longer with us.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have an office in your county government structures labeled as Urban Renewal, Housing and Project Management.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: We have that department. We do not have such an officer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have that department, yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What is the content of that letter?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The entire letter?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, would you read the first paragraph.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Proposed construction and completion of four number stadia within Nairobi.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, read the first paragraph.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: A cite visit conducted on 12th September, 2018 at Dandora established the following: That we have continued to do works that were not in the contract, bills of quantities and drawings, especially the heavily reinforced and expansive concrete terraces.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What was the company doing?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Sonko
entries.text: Constructing the stadium.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: With what materials?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: But there is an addendum.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: With what materials, governor? We will come to that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am not an engineer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: With what materials were being used; concrete or steel?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You have deviated from reinforced concrete terraces but it is not me. I am not---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It is okay, governor. Read. What deviation was done?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You have deviated from reinforced concrete terraces and preparing grounds for steel terraces.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Leave with me to Page 841. Are you there?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Confirm that, that is a report from Public Procurement and Regulation Authority (PPRA) dated 23rd September, 2019, yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: If you are there then move very fast to Page 856.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Would you read entry or Paragraph No. 5.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Sonko
entries.text: Forgery of documents.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, read.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text:
It reads:

"

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The contract documents appeared to have been forged including a Cabinet Memo to state that the stadium should be steel structures when the work is at 70 per cent complete".

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Continue.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It goes on: "All the photocopied documents submitted to the authority by the county government of Nairobi were not certified as true copies of the originals as demanded by the authority. Therefore, it was not possible for the authority to conclude that the documents were either authentic or otherwise. It was not able". They could have been authentic or not because the documents were not submitted on time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The authority is saying there was a variation of the tender terms, yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Even there was an addendum done which is okay.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I will come to that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The world has gone the steel way.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Go to Page 857 and you read entry number 6 or Paragraph 6 (c). What is the content?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It states: "All the documents submitted to the authority by the county government of Nairobi were not certified as true copies. It was just to certify. They were not certified as the true copies of the originals as demanded by the authority".

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes. Proceed to Paragraph (d)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Which one, (e) of (d)?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The (d) for dog?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: "The county government paid the contractor an amount of---" No, this was a lie, it was not.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Read.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text:
Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko\n(The Governor of Nairobi City County)

"

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: The Governor of Nairobi City County
entries.text: The county government paid the contractor an amount of Ksshs196,876,000 as envisaged by the payment record highlighted herewith."

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes. That is Page 857. How much money was paid, governor?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This is not a correct figure. What was paid was only Kshs90 million as per the last---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I want you to read what is written, not what was---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Sonko
entries.text: This document did not originate from us. I cannot say this amount was paid. I cannot mislead the House. I am on oath. We have correct figures from our affidavit on how much was paid.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I want you to read what is there not what you know.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, this is not our document. I cannot own it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I know. I have not asked you to own. I want you to read. How much money is in issue?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: They are alleging that Kshs196 million was paid but this is a lie. It was less that Kshs100 million.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Go to Paragraph 7. Read Paragraph 7.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am there. It is recommendations.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What is the content in Paragraph (a)?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: "It is the authority's considered opinion that the subject contract document and the annexures attached to this report should be subjected to more investigations to determine---"

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Should be subjected to investigations.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: But the investigation was still ongoing. It was to determine whether they have been forged or not including cabinet memorandum to state that the stadium should be steel when the work is nearing completion.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Was this report brought to your attention as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO)?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. They are my juniors who were relevant---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Does that mean that in your governance, it is true what was testified by Ms. Janet Ouko Muthoni that you have a dysfunctional system and that is why this was never brought to your attention?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Was this brought to your attention?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: But there are officers who are---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Was this brought to your attention?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It was brought maybe to my County Executive Committee Members (CECs), County Secretaries, or Chief Officers.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I read the law to you that you are the most and the buck stops with you about accountability.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, you are lying to the House.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Okay. I want to refer you to your Paragraph 48 appearing on Page 12 document labeled 10 (h). It is the Governor's document. Governor, you can have this for purposes of expediency.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.speaker_title: (The Governor of the Nairobi City County)
entries.text: Which page?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, I want you to refer to this. Have a look at that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, I am there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Would you kindly read that? Confirm that this is your affidavit.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, I deny in total charges in Paragraph---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Confirm that this is your affidavit.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Read Paragraph 45.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I deny in total the charges in Paragraph 1 (e) as I have no role to play in the procurement, which is true, of goods and services. The issue of the construction of Dandora Stadium is being investigated by the authorities.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: By the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I have not finished the statement.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: By the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC).

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You have told me to read. Let me finish.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is the matter being--- Governor, we want to save time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The issue of construction of the stadium is being investigated by other authorities and agencies like EACC

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Good. So, it is within your knowledge from your deposited' documents that the matter is being investigated.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The investigations are maybe still ongoing.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have seen your officer saying and advising on the question of the variation, yes?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: That is not my officer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You deny your officer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: She is no longer with us. I do not know her.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am not asking the person. I am asking the office of that officer. Is it still in existence?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes it is but the current officer has not---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Has Dandora Stadium been completed?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, it is not.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What was the completion period?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: One and a half years.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: How many years down the line now?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The construction was suspended.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What has stalled the construction?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: We did an addendum. We wanted to---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What has stalled the construction?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The investigations which are still ongoing.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, allow me to yield to Mr. Milimo Benson. He has two or three more limbs. You gave latitude to the other witnesses.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: How much more time do you want because one hour is over.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: We need about 30 minutes only. He has the issue of the daughter flying to the United States of America (USA). He is going to deal with it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Okay. I will give you 30 minutes. Time is not a strategy. It will end.

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (Laughter)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: As I go and yield, did you have a look at the videos that were played here yesterday?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. I was not in the House. My lawyers had a look.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Did they inform you what was played?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Ndegwa Njiru
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Have you rebutted that evidence?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, Hon. Members, Mr. Milimo is my name. I will take the last few portions of cross-examination of the Governor. Mr. Governor, I want you confirm that you are the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the County Government of Nairobi.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, you are aware that MCAs as well as yourself are both elected leaders.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You agree with me- because we are going to corporate quickly- that both the county assembly members and the governor are independent offices that have independent mandate.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You agree that both the county assembly and the governor are accountable organs of the county government and that none of them has a right to gag the other.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: : It depends on the circumstances.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes. However, generally, you have no right to gag the other.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. If they divert public funds, I can deal with as provided for in the law.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You agree with me that both the governor and the county assembly must be accountable for all purposes and intends.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, do you agree with me that one of the things that will bring about accountability is the impeachment process that is before you?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am not aware.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you agree with me that you went to court to stop this process of impeachment?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: There was a court case.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes. In that ruling, the court denied to stop the process of impeachment.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. There was an ongoing case.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Was there a ruling at any point delivered on the question whether or not the impeachment will proceed?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am not aware because I have not been in court. What I know our orders were extended. That was the budget case before Justice Mwarima.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes. However, you are aware you filed a case petition number 35 in Employment and Renumerations Court?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The case is still active in court.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Are you aware whether a ruling was delivered on the 9th of December, 2020?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: We were told to go back to court.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am asking a question. Are you aware that a ruling was delivered on 9th of December, 2020 on the question of whether or not these impeachment proceedings will proceed?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I will have to confirm with my records because I have not gone to court from that time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Very well. Are you aware that the court dismissed your request or prayer seeking that these impeachment proceedings be stopped?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Those are normal processes in court. You can---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Aye you aware?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am aware.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: All the issues you have talked about relating to court processes, unless you want selective recollection of evidence are things that are not within your knowledge.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The rule is very clear. It does not talk about court orders. It takes about any active matter in court.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have avoided that question. Nevertheless, we shall proceed. One of the things I want to ask is that you are aware you were invited when the impeachment proceedings commenced at the county assembly? Were you or were you not?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I was invited. My lawyers proceeded to the assembly with the documents and they were stopped by the serjeant-at-arms. I was aware that---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Let us go slow. The date you were to appear was on 3rd December 2020. That is the date when the impeachment Motion was tabled. Correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Do you remember the advice or direction you were given on your mode of appearance on that day of 3rd December 2020?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mbuvi Sonko Sonko
entries.text: I do not remember.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have talked about evidence relating to 2017, 2016 and 2019; you cannot remember something that happened a few weeks ago?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Answer the question. Do you remember the mode you were asked to appear? The mode of appearance.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I do not remember because the service was not properly done.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: There are two ways of appearance. Are you aware that you can appear physically or virtually?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I learnt it from the Senate when the Speaker made the communication.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Do you recall that you were supposed to appear virtually? Yes or No?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You do not recall. Were you advised on how to appear?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: An appearance can even be---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Were you advised? Did the letter state to you?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: My lawyer came physically.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It is not about whether your lawyer came. The question is, in that letter, was there a direction of how you would appear?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I do not remember.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You cannot remember.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: So, when you send your lawyer to go to the County Assembly, was it on your own volition or based on the direction from the Assembly?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Sorry. Can you repeat the question, please?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: When you sent your lawyers to go to the Assembly to appear for you, did you read the letter that invited you there or you did it on your own volition?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: If I am lost, in my legal matters it is up to them to handle the issues. They can represent me on my behalf.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: So, you did not bother whether or not there was any direction in the letter of invitation.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: If the lawyers came, then they knew what they were doing.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: So, that is for your lawyers.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have said so much about the proceedings of 3 December 2020. You are aware that a County Assembly just as is this Senate is a House of record.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, you also agree that the record of such Assembly or Senate proceedings is a conclusive evidence of what transpired on that particular day or event.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Sorry, come again.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Milimo Benson
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The record of such a House is the conclusive evidence of what transpired on such a particular event or proceeding.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. The Senate is respected. They do not break the law like what transpired in the Assembly. So, you cannot compare the Assembly and the Senate.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, but at least the prima facie evidence or the evidence is the record of what transpired.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: For the Senate and the Assembly is very different.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Okay, for the Senate, what is the record? The record is conclusive, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: For the Senate is okay, but for the Assembly they commit many illegalities. You saw what happened and aware of what transpired. There were no numbers and they have been forging signatures of Members of County Assembly (MCAs). In the Senate, the Speaker or the Clerk not forge signatures of Members. We have some crooks in the Assembly, your clients. This is a House of integrity. You cannot compare it with people swindling taxpayers' money.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Governor, stick to what you have been asked. Do not go there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I was asking that those words be withdrawn. Those are elected leaders and cannot be labeled as crooks.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: They can be. They have been stealing. It is in the public domain and they have been charged in courts.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Nonetheless, we will proceed. Governor, you aware that this impeachment process especially referring to the Count Assembly has different organs that handle the paperwork and everything at different times.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Does the office of the Clerk have any role to play? Clerk of the County Assembly?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: They do not have a role?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am not a MCA, so I am not conversant with the Standing Orders of the Assembly.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Does the Office of the Speaker have any role to play in the impeachment process at County Assembly?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Are you aware that for purposes of all the papers that are delivered to the County Assembly, they are normally delivered to the Clerk of the Assembly.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Therefore, the Clerk is the accounting officer for purposes of the papers relating to this impeachment proceeding tabled before you.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You appear to have had a problem with the papers that were delivered to the County Assembly.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: My lawyers will handle that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, did you at any point in time invite or ask the Senate to summon the clerk of the County Assembly to answer to any issues relating to the papers that were delivered at the County Assembly?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The witnesses summoned---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Did you summon or did you not?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The application was in our witness statements so I am not aware. I have not seen the witness statement. We did not read all the volumes of the affidavits.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Did you ask for summons against the Clerk or not?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I will have to consult my lawyers.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You will have to consult your lawyers. You cannot remember?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The other thing is that you appear to have a problem with the proceedings that commenced, went on and continued at the County Assembly. You appear to have a problem with the impeachment proceedings at the County Assembly of Nairobi.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The law was not followed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: At any point in time did you ask the Senate to summon the accounting organ of the County Assembly?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: We requested for MCAs to be summoned to testify, but because of time, we were not able to do that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: So you did not ask the Speaker to be availed to answer to any issues that you would have?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is not me to request for the Speaker. We have our witnesses, you have your witnesses.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Governor, you referred to a certain document at page 221 Volume 10H which is a letter dated 7th December. All I want you to confirm is that you are the boss of the Nairobi City County Executive.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Confirm to me that this is a letter written by one of your officers to you.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Come again.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You indicated issues relating to the Director of Criminal Investigations. I want to put a direct question: Is this letter emanating from the Director of Criminal Investigations?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: This is an officer from the Criminal Investigations Department (CID). We have a county unit for CID and police officers seconded to us by the National Police Service (NPS).

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The letterhead on page 221 is for which organ?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: That is for Nairobi City County.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Nairobi City County, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Any matters pertaining to investigations are being handled by the CID officers attached to the County.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Let us go slow. Is there anywhere that somebody is saying here that this is an officer attached to county?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Where is it?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The Director Investigation and Information analysis, we do not own the charge sheet. It is from the National Police Service.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Am asking, in the document I have referred you to, this is at page 221, confirm to me that the document is under the letterhead of your County Government.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, these are CID officers from the DCI office attached to the County Government of Nairobi to do investigations.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, the second question is, this letter is written to you as their boss. Correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, this is a memo because there were ongoing instructions. So they were briefing me they have succeeded in arresting the suspects and they now wanted funds to go to Homa Bay and others to Rift Valley, to gather for some more evidence.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Very good. Of course you agree with me that your officers have no right of the county to arrest any person.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: These are CID officers attached to the County.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am talking about the County officers and not the CID.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: They have a right to arrest.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: On a criminal charge?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Under which law?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The National Police Standing Orders---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I am talking about county officers.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: These are Criminal Investigation Department (CID) officer attached to the county.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have no evidence of that attachment, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The ones who conducted the arrest, not the county officers.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: No problem, let us go on, Governor. You shall recall that this letter had specific purpose that you have not disclosed to this House. I want to refer you to the last paragraph on page 222 of the same documents. The next page.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Page 222?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes. Look at the last paragraph. What was this officer seeking? This is a director of investigation information analysis. What is he seeking in that paragraph?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Once our CID officers---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Read it. What is he seeking?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The case.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What is he seeking?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: You have told me to read. Let me read. You cannot ask two questions at the same time.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is okay, Governor.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The case requires traveling because we have witnesses in Homa Bay. There are schools which are there and students are going to receive bursaries.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: So, what is he seeking?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: There are letters which were written. He says, in Homa Bay County and some areas of Rift Valley. Therefore, we require urgent facilitation like fuel." If they spend there three or four days, accommodation, money for food and facilitations to enable us prove---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Very good. Thank you, Governor. This person is seeking for money.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Facilitation.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Facilitation in terms of money to go and do whatever they were supposed to do. Correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Fuel, accommodation--- I can say yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The long and short of it is money. Is that not?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Imprest, yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The reason why you put a lot of flower and juicy information in this is so that you can top the money?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: There is nothing like "flower." They are poor students and they were being denied bursary funds.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: I put it to you that all that language was so that you then release more facilitation to this officer?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. This habit has been there. The scandal has been there since 2016. We are the ones who stopped it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you, Governor. First, is the Mover of the Motion that brought you here among the people who have been charged with all these charge sheets that you have read out? Is he among any of those who have been charged?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, he has not been charged, but he is among the people who are supposed to be charged any time from now. Even check for his constituency which has a court case.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Of course, you are not the Director of Criminal Investigation (DCI).

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, I am not an investigator. I just do the investigation report.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have no power to arrest yourself, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I cannot.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You have talked about diverted cheques by Members of the County Assembly (MCA). I will refer you particularly to page 229 of the same document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Page 229?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, page 229 of the same document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, I am there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: This is a document that you referred to. The simple thing that I want to ask you is, is there any MCA who has been charged in respect to this alleged investigations?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The Personal Assistants (PA), wives--- There is no MCA.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Is there any MCA?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: There is no MCA who can open a fixed school account in his name, but their proxies like wives and PAs---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Let us go to the next question, Governor. There is no MCA who has been charged. You also referred to a certain document---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: There are proxies who have been charged.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You cannot say that. You have no mandate to say that.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It has been said in the investigation report. The PA to the MCA of Karen and the wife to the PA. These are proxies of MCAs.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is okay.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: In fact, in your letter, that is your proxy.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is okay. You have also referred to many documents. There is a document you referred to at some point that had not been admitted to this. You said so many things. You said that it is for Hansard purposes. You mentioned names, you called in a lot of evidence that relates to this. All I want to confirm to you is that the information you were reading is from that document that was not admitted by this House, but you said that it is for Hansard purposes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, I requested. The synopsis behind that was not properly explained. For instance, the bank statements were very voluminous. They were over 1000 pages. We went and certified this morning. By the time we were bringing them to the House, were time barred. I have renewed that application to the hon. Speaker, so we will wait to see if he will allow it, especially the one for the Kshs297, 500, 000

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you, Governor. All I am asking is that that document was not admitted.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I leave that to the Speaker to---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Secondly, are you aware that such information that all you said from that document is not admissible because the document is not before the House? Yes, or no. Are you aware?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Of what?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You are not aware?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The document has been authenticated. It has been certified.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is okay. Thank you, Governor. I will go to one of the most sensitive issues that you have been referred to. Seeing that you opened up yourself, I want to open up, I want to quickly refer you. You have a daughter by the name of Saumu? The

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: We have children.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: This issue has been contentious. You agree that it is your daughter?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes, she is my daughter.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: You agree with all of us that your daughter has never been employed as a county officer in Nairobi City County?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: She has never been employed as a county officer.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you so much. Nevertheless, you agree with us that your daughter travelled at some point to the US?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is true.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: All I would want this House to know is the capacity she travelled in.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: As a woman and part of the delegation. Even the President and governors travel with their families and the costs are met by the Government.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Therefore, all that we are interested to know is that she went as part of the delegation.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: That was confirmed and we have that letter

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is okay. All we are interested to know is whether any money was spent on her travel by Nairobi City County Government.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Nothing was transferred to her account. We can even bring the statement to prove. We catered for some of the expenses even for my wife such as accommodation.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The County Assembly respects your wife, so do I. I do not want to go to your family. All I am asking is whether any of Nairobi County Government money was spent on your daughters subject travel.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: ): Come again on that question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Was there any money from the County Government of Nairobi that was spent to facilitate or otherwise be utilised by your daughter to travel to the US?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: There was no money spent?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Apart from the air ticket.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Was the air ticket paid for by the county?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I think for my wife, it was paid by the county. That was in 2018/2019 and I cannot remember everything but nothing was transferred to my wife or my daughter. If you need proof, we can bring that statement for you to confirm.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is okay. You have answered that it was paid. Governor, I want to refer you to your own document that you produced to us here. It is written D10 Volume 3 of your documents starting from pages423 to 657. Look at page 612.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Which page have you said?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Page 612.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I am there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Of course you agree that these are your own documents. Is that so?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: But I am not the author of that document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Okay, but these are your own documents because you are the one who brought them here. You can see there are two names. I want to avoid the first name. I want to go to the second person named there. With a lot of respect, just read the name of that person written there.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is not clear.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It is your document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is our document which we were to use to cross-examine the witnesses who were supposed to come. This is not a county document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: But you are the author of that document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No. You can check the author. It is a company called Premium Agency.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: But you brought it yourself.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: We were supposed to cross-examine a witness on it. There is a reason why this document is in my affidavit.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimu
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Then I will allow you to read it together with our 9C if my learned can refer you to it. If my colleague is not ready, I can hand over the same document to the Governor. It is the same document 9C which is at page 1126. Governor, I am requesting that you do for us one question only.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Proceed.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you, Governor. You can see there are two names indicated or stated in that document. I am interested in the second name. Kindly just read. I am sorry it is actually 1128, which is the same document you referred us to. Kindly read the second name there which is the same document that you referred us to.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Premier Plan, the name is Salome Agnes Mbuvi who is my daughter.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What is the designation of that?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is written ward administrator but my daughter is not a ward administrator. I am not the author of this document.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Of course, you brought it to us.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: We brought it so that we can question. We had come to testify but we were not given a chance.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: No problem. Thank you, you have answered the question.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: It is not me, not my daughter, not my wife. There is a company called Premier Plan.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Very well. Of Course, in the same document I want to refer you quickly to page 1133. I am interested in the seventh line. This is a document of imprest warrant. Do you agree with me?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: What is the nature of the duty that is being stated in that document?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I do not know where you are referring to.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It is handwritten.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Being imprest for---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: "Being imprest" for what? Can I read it for you? The document reads:- "Being imprest for county first lady and ward administrator to travel to USA."

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is what the document reads.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly
entries.text: (Mr. Benson Milimo: This is a document from your institution. Is that correct? It is an imprest warrant, do you agree? What is the amount stated up there? "Apply for---"

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: The amount is Ksh2.6million payable to Joyce Kinyanjui and not my wife or my daughter or myself.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you. We have stated what that is. Thank you, up to that level. We go next very quickly. There is a letter that you referred to at page 59 Volume 10H. Confirm that that letter is dated 23rd November, 2020.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Confirm that that letter is dated 23rd November, 2020.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Yes, and that is a letter that is written by yourself.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: My office, signed by myself.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Signed by yourself. So, when was the impeachment Motion tabled at the County Assembly?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I think on 26th.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: On 26th November, 2020, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: So, the date of your letter is 23rd, correct?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Was this letter at any point in time copied to the Mover of the Motion?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: No, because he is under investigation.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: It was not copied to him.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: So that you wrote this letter, not copied to him and you want to allege that the reason for tabling of the Motion was because of this letter?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: But he is aware because he was summoned by the Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI). His name appears.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Very well. I want to put it to you, governor, that you wrote this letter after you got wind of the intended impeachment proceedings to blackmail.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
entries.text: I disagree with you because the letter was received on the same date.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Benson Milimo
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Okay, thank you.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Mike Mbuvi Sonko
